compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for an application that allows users to mix audio with video. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Title Bar**: At the top, there is a title bar with the text "Mix Audio With Video" and a checkmark icon, likely indicating an option to confirm or save the current settings or changes.

2. **Video Preview**: Below the title bar, there is a video preview window showing a video of a bun inside an oven. A play button is overlaid on the video, suggesting that the video can be played.

3. **Audio and Record Options**: At the bottom of the screen, there are two buttons labeled "Audio" and "Record." These buttons likely allow the user to either select an audio file to mix with the video or to record new audio to be added to the video.

The overall functionality of this UI screen is to enable users to add or mix audio with a video clip.
